dct_description_sm: Map of a U.S. Department of the Interior Geological Survey of the Delaware - New Jersey Quadrangle. The city of Wilmington is visible in upper right corner of map. The Elsinboro and Lower Penns Neck section of New Jersey are visible in middle and lower right. Surveyed in 1904, reprinted 1944.
